claims.content: Customer navigates to a Product Details page for an active auction item.
System displays the current high bid, time remaining, and the 'Place Bid' input field.
Customer enters a bid amount into the 'Place Bid' field that meets or exceeds the minimum increment (typically $1.00 over the current high bid).
System validates that the Customer is logged in. If not, the system redirects to the login/registration page (see Use Case: Register/Login).
System validates that the entered bid amount is higher than the current high bid plus the minimum increment.
System checks if the Customer has a valid payment method (Credit Card/PayPal) on file. If not, the system prompts the user to add one.
System processes the bid and updates the product page with the new high bid.
System displays a confirmation message to the Customer indicating the bid was successfully placed.
The bid amount is recorded in the system as the new high bid for the auction item.
The Customer's 'My Bids' page is updated to reflect the new bid.
If the Customer was outbid, their previous high bid status is removed.
The Product Details page displays the updated current high bid and time remaining.
A confirmation message is displayed to the Customer indicating the successful bid placement.
